reviewer: same-session self-review by the implementing agent; NOT an independent review
scope: native/src/GuardRuntime.cpp (tick, pose, shoot, observe, menu, poseLog, reload)
superseded assertions in tests/test_v27_guard_resilience.py and tests/test_v28_runtime.py

findings.finding: A move refused by floor support / swept clearance kept the previous yaw silently; the 2 s pose log showed yaw != desired without the reason.
findings.outcome: fixed: Slot::moveRefusal printed as moveRefused= in 'guard v29 pose'.

findings.finding: v29 native test compared entered(10.6) after begin(10); 10.6-10 is 0.5999999999999996 in binary floating point.
findings.outcome: fixed in the test (10.61); policy keeps >= GuardEnterSeconds.

checked_without_findings: Yaw convention: rz(yaw)*(0,-1,0) == gunDirection(yaw,0) and aimFromWorld inverts it; operator at rz(yaw)*(0,151,0) faces the bore.
guardTrackYaw output stays within [-60.001, 60.001] for any in-range input, so pose() and guardGrip() never see an out-of-sector yaw.
Fire alignment: |error| <= 0.25 deg implies |bore - horizontal| <= 0.0044 < 0.006 required by shoot(); tracking reaches the bearing exactly while the target moves slower than 20 deg/s.

Turret collision (bhkCompressedMeshShape) spans only the pedestal (+-91.7 x +-88.5 x 0..35 u); the operator capsule at radius 151 never enters it, so the swept clearance rays cannot be blocked by the gun itself.
NIF Fire/Reset sequences animate CTRL_BRAZO_I/D, Cuerda_I/D and VIROTE_VISUAL only, never CTRL_GIRO_360.
Locking: observe() still takes only observationsMutex_ and never holds it across OAR calls; requestClip on the main pump holds mutex_ but releases observationsMutex_ before OAR.
All shoot() target, trajectory, protected-actor, projectile-contract and live revalidation checks are unchanged.
residual_risks: Feet slide while the mount turns (accepted by the original clip contract).

If own-clip samples are structurally absent while the guard is on screen, the 3 s / 6 s re-request causes a visible hold re-entry every 6 s; visible in the log as repeated 'guard v29 hold re-request'.
Per-frame SetPosition/SetRotation may fight AI turn-to-face; unmeasured jitter.
Platform railings may stop tracking at some angles; the guard keeps the grip at the last valid yaw (moveRefused= in the log).
No body gesture on fire; the hold clip stays active during launch and reload.
